memory.units: MEM KB fields are integer-truncated KiB; SystemInfo readings are exact bytes

measurement_limits: Spoken requests use random seeds; their PCM hashes were recorded, not compared. This is not a PCM mismatch.
RTF exact audio uses reference sample counts; legacy summaries divide by two-decimal logged audio durations.
First I2S submission excludes DMA and acoustic latency.
Observer wall time includes polling, planned start delays and inter-utterance pauses.
Heap statistics are capability-specific; physical RAM, linker remainder and contiguous allocatable blocks are different quantities.
One board, one full paragraph run and one human listener. No acoustic latency, microphone/conversation, cold power-cycle or factory cloud/motor regression measurements.
